title: DataChanalyst
text:
I am a lifelong painter and artist, having dabbled in mediums both digital and traditional. I use Procreate on the iPad, oil paint and watercolor, or just my sketchbook and a pencil. I visually bring to life the fantasy worlds that reside in my head.
I’m a researcher and data analyst with 8+ years of experience turning complex survey and behavioral data into insights that inform organizational decision-making. My work sits at the intersection of rigorous statistical methods and human-centered research questions.
I blog about social issues, online trends, and the academic research rabbit holes I fall down. I am also working on an epic 6-part fantasy series on my spare time.
